description: Lossless rate-ledger selector over raw bytes vs reversible article-geometry/title page ordering, using the strongest measured FX2-SC byte-split/direct/extra/page-match backend.
deps: C++ runtime for the bundled cmix/fx2 binary
basis: Combines the best measured raw-stream FX2-SC sidecar backend with a reversible geometry/title transform, but admits the transform only when its compressed archive is smaller than the raw-stream archive on the exact input.
expected_use: Frontier candidate for exact 10MB and promoted 100MB measurements before any full-corpus claim. It cannot be worse than the selected raw/geometry backend path except for the one-byte mode tag.
